title: Building Malchus: how a feeling becomes speech, and speech a world
overview:
*Malchus* of *Atzilus* is the world of speech, the last *hei*. Before the *nesira* it was only the back of *Zeir Anpin*; then each of its *sefiros* is built from the *Malchus* of the matching *sefira* of *Zeir Anpin*, the point where a feeling becomes a felt *yesh*. *Zeir Anpin* is the *tzelem*, the original; *Malchus* is the *dmus*, its print, like the Rebbe on video, a voice over the phone or a copy of the Mona Lisa: the same for what it carries, not the same as a thing. In speech a feeling becomes a separate thing, so the anger a man wants to express is heard in his voice.

To be built, *Malchus* first becomes a point: to speak, first be silent and think, and people will listen. Then it is face to face with *Zeir Anpin*, a speech fully written inside; beyond that its *Malchus*, practiced before the mirror, breaks through the screen and moves the listeners in *Beriya*. This is the large *dalet* of *echad*, built by *chachma* and *bina* and sent out to rule; poor, *dal*, with nothing of its own, rooted in *chesed*.

sections.title: Malchus of Atzilus, the world of speech, sawn from the back of Zeir Anpin
sections.summary: *Malchus* of *Atzilus* is the world of speech, the last *hei* of the Name. Before the *nesira* it was part of the back of *Zeir Anpin*; after it, each *sefira* of *Malchus* is built from the *Malchus* of the matching *sefira* of *Zeir Anpin*, the point where a feeling becomes a felt *yesh*.

phrases.he: (מז) ומעתה יש להבין בבחינת המלכות דאצילות שנקרא עולם הדבור, בחינת רחל, עלמא דאתגליא, אימא תתאה, והוא ה"א אחרונה דשם יהו״ה (כידוע בענין כאמה בתה, דה"א עילאה דבינה אוזיפת ה׳ גבורות מנצפ"ך לברתא, בחינת ה' מוצאות הפה דדבור כנזכר לעיל) ונקרא מאמר פתוח, כמו ויאמר אלהי״ם, וכמו שכתוב בדבר ה' שמים כו', ועל זה אמר מלכותו בכל כו' כידוע

blocks.text: Reviewing the chapter at the end of the next class: *Malchus* of *Atzilus* is *Rachel*, *alma d'isgalya* (the revealed world), the last *hei* of the Name. Both are called *hei* because, among other reasons, *bina* lends the five *gevuros*, *mantzepach*, to *Malchus*.
blocks.outOfPlace: From the review of the chapter at the end of the next class (226); the class reads these lines with no comment of its own.

phrases.he: דהנה ידוע בענין הנסירה שד"ו פרצופין היו כו', דהיינו שבחינת המלכות היתה כלולה בבחינת אחוריים דזעיר אנפין, כמו שכתוב עצם מעצמי כו', כי מאיש לוקחה זאת כו' ואחר הנסירה נבנית המלכות בבנין פרצוף בפני עצמו באורות וכלים, כמו שכתוב ויבן יהו״ה אלהי״ם את הצלע כו'. וביאור הדברים ידוע בזהר ועץ חיים בכמה דוכתי, דהמלכות נקרא עשירית כי נלקחה מעשיראה דכל עשר ספירות דזעיר אנפין, דהיינו מבחינת מלכות של כל ספירה דזעיר אנפין כמו מבחינת מלכות דחכמה דזעיר אנפין נמשך בחינת חכמה דמלכות, ומבחינת מלכות דחסד דזעיר אנפין נמשך חסד דמלכות כו', ועל דרך זה נבנו כל עשר ספירות דמלכות

blocks.text: Then the *nesira* (the sawing apart): *Malchus* was in the *achoraim* (the back) of *Zeir Anpin*, and from the *Malchus* of each of its *sefiros* came that *sefira* of *Malchus*.
blocks.outOfPlace: From the review of the chapter at the end of the next class (226); the class reads these lines with no comment of its own.

phrases.he: וביאור בחינת מלכות דט' ספירות דזעיר אנפין ידוע, שהוא בחינת ההתגלות של כל מדה וספירה כשבאה בבחינת גלוי ליש ודבר מה במציאת ניכרת כו' כמו מדת אהבה כשבאה בגלוי יש כו'

blocks.text: The *Malchus* of each of the nine *sefiros* of *Zeir Anpin* is where the attribute comes out as a *yesh*, something noticed: love felt as a thing. The feeling comes into a sort of *osios* (letters), and a person knows what he is feeling.

In the review: the *Malchus* of a *sefira* is its coming out as a noticed *yesh*, as at *Ana Emloch* (I shall rule), where it is engraved. A person loves, hates or is angry, often vaguely; its *Malchus* is where he says to himself, so to speak, "I love this thing": that gives the feeling its *yeshus*. From it comes that *sefira* of *Malchus*.
blocks.outOfPlace: From the review of the chapter at the end of the next class (226); the class reads these lines with no comment of its own.

sections.title: Tzelem and dmus: the original and its copy
sections.summary: *Zeir Anpin* is the *tzelem*, the form itself; *Malchus* is the *dmus*, the print the seal leaves, like the Rebbe on video or a voice over the telephone. For what it carries the copy makes no difference; as a thing it is not the original, like a copy of the Mona Lisa.

phrases.he: והנה בחינת ההתגלות הזאת העצמיות נקרא צלם וצורה העצמית, כציור העצמי דחותם וכהאי גוונא, וכן ציור הפנים עצמו כו' והיינו בחינת הכלים דזעיר אנפין, שעל זה אמר איהו וגרמוהי חד,
שהוא כענין הגבול בכח
phrases.en: It's not the actual *gvul*: the *kelim* of *Zeir Anpin* is not the actual *gvul* but a power for the *gvul*.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב למעלה (באות כ"ט)

blocks.text: This self-revelation is called the *tzelem* (image), the essential form, like the form of a *chosam* (seal) or of the face itself. It is the *kelim* of *Zeir Anpin*, of which it says "He and His organs are one": **not the actual *gvul* but a power for the *gvul***.

phrases.he: אבל בחינת דמות בנוקבא דזעיר אנפין, שנקרא דמות כבוד יהו״ה דזעיר אנפין כידוע בענין נעשה אדם בצלמינו כדמותינו, דצלם בדכורא ודמות בנוקבא כו' והיינו ענין אתוון אתגליפו כו', שהוא בחינת התגלות להתגלות כאותיות החותם הנחקק בשעוה וכהאי גוונא כו'

blocks.text: The *dmus* (likeness) is in the *Nukva*: in "Let us make man in our *tzelem*, after our *dmus*", the *tzelem* is in the male and the *dmus* in the female. It is the engraved letters, a revelation of a revelation: the *tzelem* is the mold, the *dmus* the letter it prints.

blocks.title: The Rebbe on video
blocks.text: The *dmus* is exactly like the original, but only a likeness. A video of the Rebbe talks and everything, almost like *mamash* seeing him, yet it is not his *tzelem*: it is a *dmus*.

blocks.title: A voice over the telephone
blocks.text: Speech is a *dmus* of the inner *middos*, yet the voice has its own *tzelem*, which gets engraved into the telephone. A listener in Los Angeles does not hear the voice, which does not carry that far, but a reconstruction: the voice turned into electrical impulses, and back into airwaves by the phone at the other end.

So it is a *dmus* of a *dmus* of a *dmus*, the voice itself being a *dmus* of the *tzelem* in the emotions and intellect; that is why *Malchus* is called a *dmus*. Yet for all intents and purposes the listener might as well hear the actual voice, like a seal's letters pressed into wax.

In the review: *Zeir Anpin*, the male, is the *tzelem*, still part of the actual form; speech, the female, is a *dmus*. In the voice you hear the love or the anger, not its *etzem*. And being a *dmus* makes no difference, as with the Rebbe on video.
blocks.outOfPlace: From the review of the chapter at the end of the next class (226); the class reads these lines with no comment of its own.

blocks.title: The Mona Lisa and the Bill of Rights
blocks.text: Yet in some ways it does make a difference. A copy of the Mona Lisa can be exactly like the original, but it is not worth a hundred million dollars (though some forgeries are good enough to be worth a lot themselves). A copy of the Constitution or the Bill of Rights carries the whole idea exactly, but only the original document is worth millions. From one side it is the same; from the other it is not: only a *dmus*.
blocks.outOfPlace: Added in the review at the end of the next class (226), to the tzelem and dmus of these lines.

blocks.text: So too *Atik*, a *he'etek*, a copy of the *ratzon ha'atzmi* (the essential will), coming through *Malchus*: the very same thing given over, yet only a copy, no longer the original.
blocks.outOfPlace: Added in the review at the end of the next class (226).

blocks.title: The Xerox machine
blocks.text: This too is *Malchus*: letters and the *dmus* carry a thing from place to place without the intellect. A Xerox machine copies this book: what a smart *Chassidishe* Xerox machine, that can copy the *Shaar HaYichud*! No: it has no idea what it says, it copied only the shapes of the letters. So with a JPEG of the book, or this class going up onto the site and down into another computer, and people say the computer is smart, giving over the whole *Shaar HaYichud*.
blocks.outOfPlace: Added in the review at the end of the next class (226); the tape ends here.

sections.title: In speech the feeling becomes a separate yesh, sefira by sefira
sections.summary: Brought out in speech, a feeling becomes a thing apart, a *yesh* of a *yesh*, that can travel across the country and across time. The *Malchus* of each *sefira*, down to the particulars, becomes that *sefira* of *Malchus*: the anger a man wants to express is the anger heard in his voice.

phrases.he: כך בחינת התגלות העצמיות שבמדה שבלב, כשבאה בבחינת התגלות יש בדבור בה' מוצאות הפה נעשה בבחינת יש נבדל בפני עצמו,
שנקרא יש דיש,
phrases.en: It's a something of a something.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב במקום אחר באריכות

blocks.text: So the attribute in the heart, come out in speech, becomes a *yesh nivdal*, a thing by itself: the voice travels to Los Angeles while the speaker stays here, and writing travels over time, as the Rebbe's letters came to us, like this book. It is *yesh d'yesh*, **a something of a something**: already a *yesh* in the *Malchus* of the *sefiros* of *Zeir Anpin*, and a *yesh* of a *yesh* where *Malchus* is built by itself.

phrases.he: וכמו בחינת חכמה שבחסד שבלב הבא בגלוי באופן מוגבל, הרי עדיין אחוז ומתאחד בעצם החכמה והחסד כו' אבל גלוי שלו בדבור, שזהו כמו מאמר יהי אור,
הוא מהות דבר נבדל בפני עצמו,
phrases.en: That's already a totally separate thing.

phrases.he: והוא בחינת חכמה שבחסד דמלכות שנמשך מבחינת מלכות דחכממה דחסד שבזעיר אנפין בדרך פרט
וכך הוא כל בנין פרטים
phrases.en: And it's like that in all the different *pratim*.

phrases.he: דעשר ספירות דמלכות באורות וכלים בפרצוף בפני עצמו כו'

blocks.text: *Chachma* within *chesed* in the heart, even revealed, is still bound up with their essence; its revelation in speech, like "Let there be light", is **already a totally separate thing**. So in the particulars: the *Malchus* of *chachma* within *chesed* of *Zeir Anpin* becomes *chachma* within *chesed* of *Malchus*.

**And it's like that in all the different *pratim***, the first, second or third order of *sefiros*: from the *Malchus* of the *sefira* of the *sefira* comes the *sefira* of the *sefira* of *Malchus*.

blocks.title: Love and anger in the voice
blocks.text: When a person feels love and wants to express it, from that comes the love in the speech; the same with anger. "You! What did you do?" comes not just from being angry but from wanting to express it. The anger went from its *Chabad*, the reason, through *Chagas*, the feeling, through *Nehi*, its *hispaalus*, to its *Malchus*, a *yesh* trying to come out; that became the anger you hear in the voice and the words.

So with *chachma*: "Wow, that was a really smart speech" comes from the *Malchus* of *chachma* becoming the *chachma* of *Malchus*. So the whole structure of ten *sefiros* of *Malchus* is built, a vessel and *partzuf* of its own.

sections.title: Before the sawing a tail; then a point that falls silent
sections.summary: Before the *nesira* *Malchus* was the back of each *sefira* of *Zeir Anpin*, with no being of its own. To be built it first becomes a point: to speak well one must first not speak, and think. Then people listen.

phrases.he: וקודם הנסירה היו ד"ו פרצופין, שכמו האחוריים שנגרר אחר הפנים, בלתי מהות בפני עצמו כך בבחינת אחוריים דכל ספירה היה נכלל בחינת התגלות דמלכות, כי יש בכלל מאתיים כו'
(וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר בפרטים ענין אחור באחור ואחור בפנים כו'
ומאן דאמר זנב היה כו')
phrases.en: It was a tail.

blocks.text: Before the *nesira*, two faces were joined: *Malchus* was like the back dragged along behind the face, with no being of its own. So in the back of each *sefira*, its wish to express itself and be a something, *Malchus* was included automatically.

blocks.title: Two ways to write a tzadik
blocks.text: So the letter *tzadik* is written two ways: *achor b'achor* (back to back), he facing forward and she backward, and *achor b'fanim* (back to face), she facing his back and seeing nothing but a brick wall, like a tenement window. Another opinion says **it was a tail**. They need not exclude each other: *Malchus* is a tail of each *sefira*.

phrases.he: ומתחלה היא נקודה תחת יסוד זעיר אנפין כו', כמו שכתוב ותפול לפני רגליו, וכמו שכתוב בזהר על פסוק עושי דברו,
אזעירת גרמה כנקודה
phrases.en: She made herself small like a *nekuda*.

phrases.he: כו' עד ה"א כמלקדמין
phrases.en: Till it becomes a *hei* just like the *hei* that was before.

blocks.text: At first she is a *nekuda* (point) under the *yesod* of *Zeir Anpin*, like a *chirik* under a *yud*: "she fell before his feet", said of Esther. The *Zohar* on "those who do His word": **she made herself small like a *nekuda***. To talk properly, first make the talk *batel* (nullified) and go into the thinking.

blocks.title: The spontaneous speech
blocks.text: Someone can make a speech spontaneously only if he knows the subject well: the going into *bina* happened earlier. To be a point under the *yud* means that in order to speak, he has to not speak.
As they say, a *meshugener* (madman) says what he thinks, and a wise man thinks what he says. Speech that never becomes a point ends up baloney and babble, with no *binyan* (structure).
For a proper structure, *Malchus* first makes itself a nothing: to finally speak, a person has to sit there without speaking.

The people everybody wants to avoid usually talk all the time without knowing what they are saying, until you wonder how to get rid of them. Speaking right away, they end up with nobody listening, and the purpose of speech is lost.
The purpose of speech is that people listen to you. That is why it is called *Malchus*: the point of a king is that they listen to him.

The craziest type of person is the one who walks around the street just talking to himself. He needs to talk so much that he doesn't even care whether anybody is listening, and nobody is. It happens because he never stops the talking in order to think.

sensitivity.reason: Calls a man who walks the street talking to himself "the craziest type of person"; it can read as mockery of the mentally ill.

blocks.title: When E.F. Hutton talks
blocks.text: The more a person stops talking to think, the wiser he is, and people listen, knowing his words come from proper thought. "When E.F. Hutton talks, everybody listens," went the advertisement (a listener's Alan Greenspan works too): he analyzed the situation before he talked, and gives good advice. That is the strange thing about *dibur* (speech): it begins *davka* by not talking.

She becomes a total nothing, **till it becomes a *hei* just like the *hei* that was before**, like *bina*: the lower *hei* becomes a point and goes up until it is like the upper one, and then everybody listens.

sections.title: Face to face, and the speech practiced before the mirror
sections.summary: Made small, *Malchus* rises to the upper *hei* and stands face to face with *Zeir Anpin*. Its building in *Atzilus* is a speech fully written inside; beyond that, the *Malchus* of *Malchus*, practiced before the mirror, breaks through the screen and becomes a *partzuf* in *Beriya*, the effect on the listeners.

phrases.he: שאחר כך נבנית בפרצוף בבחינת האצילות
עד שנעשית בבחינת פנים בפנים כו'
phrases.en: Till it becomes *panim b'panim*.

phrases.he: כדמיון מיעוט הירח ומלוי הירח
phrases.en: Like the moon that gets empty and full.

blocks.text: Then she is built into a *partzuf* in *Atzilus*, *panim b'panim* (face to face). *Zeir Anpin* looks inward toward *bina*, and *Malchus*, having made herself small, is now like the upper *hei*, where he looks: face to face, **like the moon that gets empty and full**.

phrases.he: וזהו עיקר ענין בנין המלכות, שהוא למעלה מבנין המלכות בפרצוף בבי"ע,
phrases.en: This is the *inyan* of the *binyan hamalchus* in *Atzilus*, which is higher than the *binyan hamalchus*, the *partzuf* in *Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya*.

phrases.he: שנסתר כל פרצופה שבבחינת אצילות, עד בחינת מלכות דמלכות שבוקע המסך ונעשית בבחינת פרצוף בבריאה, כמו שיתבאר כו' ודי למבין.

blocks.text: This building of *Malchus* in *Atzilus* is higher than her *partzuf* in *Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya*, where her whole *partzuf* of *Atzilus* is hidden down to the *Malchus* of *Malchus*, which breaks through the *masach* (screen) into *Beriya*.

blocks.title: The speech written and ready
blocks.text: Two things. In *Atzilus* she makes herself small for the full building of *Malchus*: the speech is written and arranged, ready to say, but not yet said, not gone out to *Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya*, the *alma d'peruda* (world of separation), where you talk to somebody else. Then the whole inner *Malchus* has to disappear and leave only the *Malchus* of *Malchus*, the letters: he goes over the speech almost to memorize it, *shagur al leshono* (fluent on his tongue).

blocks.title: Practicing before the mirror
blocks.text: Even with the whole speech built inside him, all ten *sefiros*, he is not ready to give it perfectly; he needs the building of *Malchus* of *Malchus*, with ten *sefiros* too. So he practices in front of a mirror, or tells his wife, "Here, listen to me," working out not just what to say but what to stress, where to talk low, where to sweep his hands.
blocks.outOfPlace: Class 226 opens by going back over line 25 ("Backtrack a little bit"), continuing where tape 225 broke off; the alignment marks the line a little later, inside this explanation.

blocks.text: From the built *Malchus* he knows the emotion he wants to convey: *chesed*; or, as a rabble-rouser, anger; or mercy, so they give money to the poor orphans with patches in their yarmulkes. Still he practices, so the *sefiros* of *Malchus* transfer properly to those of *Malchus* of *Malchus*.

The same rule: from *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Malchus* comes *chesed* of *Malchus* of *Malchus*. The built speech has *chesed* of *Malchus*, love he wants to convey; *gevura*, anger and hatred; *tiferes*, compassion; and within it the wish to convey it into the actual letters. That is *Malchus* of *Malchus*, which goes through to be *Keser* of *Beriya*: the speaker reaches his audience's *taanug* (delight) and *ratzon* (will) and moves them as he wants, to give money, to storm the Bastille, or to love him back.

So the building of *Malchus* in *Atzilus* is one thing; the *partzuf* hidden down to *Malchus* of *Malchus*, breaking through the *masach* into a *partzuf* in *Beriya* with ten *sefiros* of its own, is the other. He practices so that the speech breaking through is the *partzuf* he wanted; otherwise the feeling does not come across, and he is not a good speaker. He also wants people to listen, say "Wow, what a speaker," and do what he says.

That is *Malchus*: he wants to be the king, whether the rabble-rouser who wants them to storm the Bastille or a teacher conveying an idea to a class. This is *Beriya*: he makes a new creation over there, a mood, and they say "Wow." So *Malchus* of *Malchus* becomes a *partzuf* in *Beriya*, as later chapters discuss.

sections.title: The large dalet of echad: built by Abba and Ima and sent out to rule
sections.summary: The large *dalet* of *echad* is *Malchus* fully built in *Atzilus*; the small *dalet* is its *Malchus* breaking through the screen. *Chachma* and *bina* build it from the *Malchus* of the nine *sefiros* of *Zeir Anpin* and send it out to rule, for a king rules by his word, and the power of speech stays in *Zeir Anpin* even when he is silent.

phrases.he: והנה זהו באמת ענין דלית רבתי דאחד,
phrases.en: This is the real *inyan* of *dalet ravrevsa d'echad*.

phrases.he: שהוא בחינת גדלות פרצוף נוקבא דזעיר אנפין בבחינת האצילות, דוקא במוחין ומדות, אורות וכלים

blocks.question: Wasn't the large dalet of echad said to be even before the tzimtzum, and then to be tevuna? How is this the real one?
blocks.text: **This is the real *inyan* of *dalet ravrevsa d'echad***: the greatness of the *partzuf* of the *Nukva* in *Atzilus*, *davka* with *mochin* and *middos*, lights and vessels. The large *dalet* is *Malchus* in *Atzilus*; the little *dalet* is *Malchus* of *Malchus* breaking through the *masach*.

phrases.he: (כמו שכתוב ויבן יהו״ה אלהי״ם את הצלע,
שהוא אבא ואמא דאצילות, דבנו לה כו'
phrases.en: She was built by *chachma* and *bina*.

phrases.he: ואמרו לה זילי נטירי ביתך,
phrases.en: Go and take care of your house.

phrases.he: להיות ראש לבי"ע כו')
phrases.en: Now go out and be the head for *Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya*.

phrases.he: (כידוע בענין באר חפרוה שרים כו')

blocks.text: "And *Havaya Elokim* built the rib": **She was built by *chachma* and *bina***, *Havaya* being *chachma* and *Elokim* *bina*. The rib, the material, is the *Malchus* of *Zeir Anpin*, the *middos* she was taken from; but she is built from higher.

They build her and tell her, **Go and take care of your house**: **Now go out and be the head for *Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya***. The intellect builds speech out of the *middos* and sends it outside. On "the well the princes dug" there is apparently some *inyan* in *Kabbala*.

phrases.he: והענין הוא דבחינת דבור שבמחשבה הנזכר לעיל, שזהו ד' רבתי, נעשה מחשבה שבדבור העליון דזעיר אנפין בבחינת עשר ספירות אורות וכלים,
שהוא ממלכות דט׳ ספירות דזעיר אנפין כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: The *inyan* of *Malchus* is coming from the *Malchus* of the ten *sefiros* of *Zeir Anpin*.

phrases.he: והיינו א"ח ד',
phrases.en: Nine: from the nine comes the *Malchus*.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב במקום אחר באריכות
וכמו שכתוב ויהי האדם לנפש חיה, רוח ממללא,
phrases.en: The *adam* became a speaking spirit.

phrases.he: שהוא דבר מלך שלטון
phrases.en: The word of the king is the rule.

phrases.he: בי' מאמרות ויאמר אלהי״ם כו' כידוע

blocks.text: The speech in thought, the large *dalet*, becomes thought within the upper speech of *Zeir Anpin*, ten *sefiros*, lights and vessels: the nine and the *dalet*, since from the nine comes the *Malchus*. So "man became a living soul": **the *adam* became a speaking spirit**.
**The word of the king is the rule**: a king rules *davka* by his words. What he only thinks, he cannot complain is not done; what he says and you don't do is a death penalty.

blocks.title: The depth of the Megillah
blocks.text: Coming up to Purim, you see how deep the Megillah is. It seems just a story, but all of it is matters of *Malchus*: she fell at his feet; "the word of the king is the rule", so what was sealed with the king's ring cannot go back. The whole second half of *Shaarei Orah* is on Purim. Mordechai on the king's horse, in the king's clothes and crown: you think it a kiddie story, and it is all deep, *Megillas Esther*, revealing the hidden. And the king's word rules in the ten sayings: when *Elokim* said it, it had to be done.

phrases.he: ובחינת כתר דמלכות דאצילות הוא בחינת כח הדבור טרם שמתפשט לדבר,
phrases.en: That's the *hiyuli* power of speaking, before he even thinks of speaking.

phrases.he: בבחינת שכל ומדות שבדבור, שהוא ט׳ ספירות דמלכות
והיינו ענין לעולם יהו״ה דברך נצב בשמים, בחינת זעיר אנפין,
דהיינו בחינת כח הדבור שדבוק בחזה דזעיר אנפין תמיד כו',
phrases.en: In the *chazeh*, the *koach hadibur* is there even when you don't speak.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב בעץ חיים ומבואר במקום אחר

blocks.text: *Keser* of *Malchus* is the power of speech before it spreads into speaking: **the *hiyuli* power of speaking, before he even thinks of speaking**. "Forever, *Havaya*, Your word stands in the heavens": the power of speech cleaves to the *chazeh* (chest) of *Zeir Anpin*, there even when you don't speak.

sections.title: Dalet and dal: Malchus has nothing of its own
sections.summary: *Malchus* clothes the four *middos* of *Tanhi*, only their final decision, so it is a *dalet*; and it is *dal*, poor, with nothing of its own. Its root is *chesed*, the mood in which a person wants to talk, and it shines like the moon, until the time to come when the speech is as great as the thought.

phrases.he: והתפשטות המלכות מלבשת לתנה"י דזעיר אנפין,
שהוא בחינת דלי"ת,
phrases.en: That's why it's called *dalet*.

phrases.he: והמלכות נקרא דל
phrases.en: It's also called *dal* because she's small, low, poor.

blocks.text: The spreading of *Malchus* clothes *Tanhi* (*tiferes*, *netzach*, *hod* and *yesod*) of *Zeir Anpin*: **that's why it's called *dalet***. Not the *etzem* of *chesed* and *gevura*. *Tiferes*, mercy, is the connection with another person, where speech comes from; and *Malchus* clothes only its *hachraa* (decision), not the first choice between *chesed* and *gevura*.

*Nehi* is easy: it is the *hispaalus* of the *middos*, not their *etzem*. Why *tiferes*? It carries the *etzem*, but only as the final *hachraa*, after *chesed* and *gevura* are mixed, not the first *hataya* where each is full. **It's also called *dal* because she's small, low, poor**: with nothing of her own, she begs everything from others.

phrases.he: ושרש בנין המלכות מחסדים דזעיר אנפין,
phrases.en: The *shoresh* of the *binyan hamalchus* is from the *chesed* of *Zeir Anpin*.

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב והוכן בחסד כסאו,
phrases.en: The *kisei*, the *Malchus*, is *muchan davka* in *chesed*.

phrases.he: וכתיב אשרי משכיל אל דל,
וחסד ח"ס דלי"ת,
phrases.en: *Chesed* means he's *chas* on the poor person.

phrases.he: דהמלכות לית לה מגרמה כלום,
phrases.en: has nothing from itself,

phrases.he: רק מה שמקבלת מזעיר אנפין
phrases.en: only whatever it receives from *Zeir Anpin*.

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל בענין התגלות דהתגלות כו',
phrases.en: A revelation of a revelation.

phrases.he: כמשל הלבנה שמקבת מאור השמש,
וכמו שכתוב בזהר דסיהרא לית לה מגרמה כו'
phrases.en: The moon has no light of its own.

blocks.text: **The *shoresh* of the *binyan hamalchus* is from the *chesed* of *Zeir Anpin***: *Malchus*, speech, comes *davka* from *chesed*, which is spreading out.

blocks.title: "What is it?" "Nothing."
blocks.text: That is why a person wants to talk *davka* when he is happy and loving; when he is angry he usually doesn't want to talk. You go to your wife and ask, "What is it?" and she says, "Nothing," and "Don't you want to talk about it?" "Nope." When somebody doesn't want to talk about it, it means they're angry. When someone is loving and kind, he is in an expansive mood, and then he wants to talk.

sensitivity.reason: A husband-and-wife joke: the wife who answers "Nothing" when she is angry.

blocks.question: Didn't we say the building of Malchus was from chachma and bina?
blocks.text: *Chachma* and *bina* build it, from the materials of the *Malchus* of the nine *sefiros*, but the *shoresh* (root) of the building is the *chasadim* of *Zeir Anpin*: a person wants to talk *davka* from the *chasadim*.

"His throne is established in *chesed*": **the *kisei*, the *Malchus*, is *muchan davka* in *chesed***. "Happy is he who is wise toward the *dal*": *chesed* is *chas dalet*, **he's *chas* on the poor person**. *Malchus* has only what it receives, a revelation of a revelation: **The moon has no light of its own**.

phrases.he: מה שאין כן כשזעיר אנפין ונוקבא היו שוין בקומתן כמו שהיו קודם מיעוט הירח, שנקרא שני מאורות הגדולים,
phrases.en: It's not like that when they were equal.

phrases.he: וכן לעתיד לבא דכתיב והיה אור הלבנה כו'

blocks.text: **It's not like that when they were equal**, when both were the great lights, and so in the time to come: speech will be as big as thought. So when a *talmid chacham* learns his *girsa*, *davka* speaking the Torah, it becomes even higher.

sections.title: Two buildings of the Nukva: the head of the foxes, and the night
sections.summary: The *Nukva* is built twice: in *Atzilus*, by the *nesira*, and again as the head of *Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya*. There she makes herself less, the head of foxes instead of the tail of lions, and rules the night of the world of separation.

phrases.he: אך יש ב' מדריגות גם בבנין הנוקבא, הא' בבחינת האצילות שהוא ענין הנסירה כו', והב' מה שנעשית ראש לבי"ע
(והוא מה שכתוב במקום אחר בענין לכי ומעטי את עצמך כו',
phrases.en: Make yourself less.

phrases.he: שזהו בחינת המלכות שנעשית ראש לשועלים בבי"ע,
phrases.en: Instead of becoming the tail of the lions, it becomes the head of the foxes.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב ואת המאור הקטן לממשלת הלילה
ובכלל כל בחינת האצילות נקרא יום,
phrases.en: In general the *bechina* of *Atzilus* is called day.

phrases.he: ומדת לילה הוא בחינת המלכות כשמסתתרת בראש הבריאה, כמו שיתבאר בסמוך בענין ברוך שם כבוד מלכותו לעולם ועד כו', אחר בקיעת המסך כו' ודי למבין)

blocks.text: Building the *Nukva* has two levels: in *Atzilus*, the *nesira*, and as head of *Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya*. "Go and make yourself less": **instead of becoming the tail of the lions, it becomes the head of the foxes**, "the lesser light to rule the night".

**In general the *bechina* of *Atzilus* is called day**; *Malchus* hidden in the head of *Beriya*, in the *alma d'peruda*, is night. So the chapter covered the *nesira*, the building of *Malchus* in *Atzilus*, and then for action.

reviewQuestions.question: What is the difference between the *tzelem* and the *dmus*, and in what way does it make no difference, and in what way does it?
How does the *Malchus* of anger in a person become the anger heard in his speech?
Why must *Malchus* first become a point under *Zeir Anpin* before it can be built, and what does this teach about a person who wants to be listened to?
What are the two buildings of *Malchus*, and how does practicing a speech before a mirror show the second?
Why is *Malchus* called *dalet* and *dal*, and why is its root in *chesed*?
